info.title: pgko.dev
info.description:
### Authentication

Public reads are anonymous. Account and bundle management use the `site-session` cookie returned by login or registration.

Before a POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE (including login), GET `/api/config` with a cookie jar. Preserve the returned cookies and send the `x-csrf-token` response header as a request header. On `api.error.auth.csrfInvalid`, refresh them before retrying.

### Errors

Errors use stable machine-readable codes plus translation keys, for example `{ "code": "unauthorized", "message": "api.error.auth.unauthorized" }`. Validation errors also include field paths in errors. X-Request-Id correlates requests with server logs.

get.description: List public bundles anonymously. Profile listings include public and profile-only uploads and accepted collaborations. Use /api/bundles/manage for your own uploads, drafts and collaboration inbox.

get.description: Get public bundle detail by ID (released only).

Get original UGC files and exact-reference dependency mappings for this released bundle revision. Reuse file URLs until expiresAt and refresh the manifest when the bundle revision changes. URLs expire after one hour; manifest responses allow 30 seconds of private caching. Does not record a ZIP download.

post.description: Create a multipart upload session. Supply an Idempotency-Key (8–128 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens) to recover the same session after a lost response. Reusing a key with different input returns 409. Keys remain reserved until the session is cleaned up. Replays return the current status; only uploading sessions return part URLs.
